purpose: Define Master Relation as the canonical registry/index of relation identities and their owning relation contracts, enabling deterministic cross-domain relation discovery without absorbing relation semantics.

topics.name: Master Relation
topics.purpose: Define Master Relation as the canonical registry/index of relation identities and their owning relation contracts, enabling deterministic cross-domain relation discovery without absorbing relation semantics.

semantics.registry_rule: Master Relation maps relation identity to its authoritative relation definition/owner.
semantics.ownership_rule: Master Relation does not redefine or absorb relation semantics.
semantics.discovery_rule: Cross-domain relation discovery uses explicit registry identity resolution.
semantics.duplication_rule: A relation is defined once by its owner and referenced from Master Relation.
semantics.bootstrap_rule: Master Relation may be referenced by Master/Domain composition for relation discovery.
semantics.projection_rule: Relation lists/graphs are projections of registry plus definitions.

invariants.rule: Universal substrates, domain compositions, Meta ownership and relations remain explicit and non-duplicated.

hard_gates.condition: Master Relation duplicates relation semantic definition
relation authority selected by file/path/version heuristic
same active relation identity maps to multiple conflicting owners
registry entry lacks authoritative target ref
relation graph projection becomes registry authority

references.purpose: Registry points to canonical relation definitions.
Registry does not override semantic owners.

prose.summary: Define Master Relation as the canonical registry/index of relation identities and their owning relation contracts, enabling deterministic cross-domain relation discovery without absorbing relation semantics.
